areas.note: East, near castle  -  the gentle onboarding ground. Small arena, low level, orc warband.
West uplands  -  a step up. Orc warband with a chance of a skeleton band; med arena.
South toward the Wound  -  corrupted. Skeletons common, trolls appear; med arena, bigger troop.
North front line  -  the deadliest ground. Trolls lead, skeletons support; LARGE arena, largest troop.

notes: Geotagged spawn AREAS (WO-606 V1). Each area is a circle footprint (center xz + radius) in world space; a world position resolves to the containing area (nearest center on overlap). Only authored areas spawn -> moat/water/seam/non-play belong to no area = no spawns (composes with the navmesh moat carve). families[] is a weighted pool; on a draw the chosen family fills the composition's role slots (tank/dps/healer counts) with its Tank/Warrior(dps)/Mage(healer) archetype ids (Tripo roster). levelRange sets enemy level (higher farther out) and feeds the existing 'threat' int; arenaPreset is forwarded as a string (BattleArena geometry has no size param yet  -  later hook); seedBudget is the progression knob (chunk-composer WO-479) that scales count/level. Center/radius/weights are OWNER-TUNABLE. Skeleton/troll enemy DEFS+models are a fast-follow (see WORK_ORDER_606 note)  -  until statted they build with EnemyFactory fallbacks; orc-* ids are proven.
